t: This is a terrace of houses in Westminster, numbers 13 to 18 Victoria Square along with 6 Lower Grosvenor Place. It was designed by Sir Matthew Digby Wyatt, a British architect and art historian. Wyatt was Secretary of the Great Exhibition, Surveyor of the East India Company, and the first Slade Professor of Fine Art at Cambridge. He received the Royal Gold Medal in 1866. Beyond that, the material I have on the terrace itself is thin, so look at the buildings and imagine the hand behind them.
